_comment: Estavo v3 — route and navigation manifest. Single source for header, drawer, footer, sitemap and cross-page links so all 24 pages stay consistent. Master Plan v3 §4.1 defines these routes; §4.3 requires a primary action to take the user where its label promises, and forbids linking to a blank route.

cta._note: referral.js rewrites any href starting with https://brokers.estavo.space to carry the active ?ref slug. Keep that origin on platform CTAs or referral attribution silently breaks.
cta._deep_note: Deep links carry data-keep-path so referral.js keeps their path (adding ?ref and click ids) instead of routing them through /go/, which drops destinations. The app honours ?redirect= through sign-up. The game needs no account.
